update_measurement.includes: ancestor-set difference, cardinality counters and materialised bitmap edits
update_measurement.excludes: base posting maintenance, label assignment, replay generation, verification and vector-index maintenance

label_model: one direct terminal label per object; destinations may be internal concepts

verification.reference: replayed labels and raw child-edge traversal, independent of maintained postings and cached closures

limits: metadata only; no vectors or ANN calls
one direct terminal label per object, not multilabel membership
object ids are shuffled so postings are not contiguous
random destinations are concepts, not a workload model; replay uses explicit destinations
kernel timings are not end-to-end update latency
